title: FAI Harvest Seed List
description: Curated bootstrap input for the FAI Harvest pipeline (repo → Solution Play converter). Each entry is one Microsoft-anchor accelerator the cron sweep will pull through stages S1→S7 (clone → repo-facts → fact-check → manifest-v2 → policy-overlay → cost-track → publish). Distinct from `orchard-seed-list.schema.json` (Orchard A-phase fruit-catalog crawler input) — same source repos may appear in both files for different downstream consumers. Authored at Phase [H0.26]. License: CC0-1.0.

$schema.description: Optional pointer back to this schema (CDN URL). Tooling MAY use this to fetch + validate.

schema_version.description: Semver of THIS schema document. Bumped on breaking changes to the items[] shape. Consumers MUST match major.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp when the seed list was last hand-edited or pipeline-regenerated.

count.description: Number of entries in items[]. MUST equal items.length — enforced by the smoke test, not by JSON Schema (which has no cross-field arithmetic in 2020-12).

items.description: Seed entries. Order may drive cron-sweep order in priority='high' tiers; otherwise non-significant.

full_name.description: GitHub <owner>/<repo>. Case preserved exactly as it appears on GitHub. Example: Azure-Samples/azure-search-openai-demo. Same regex as orchard-seed-list.schema.json `full_name`.

priority.description: Sweep-order tier. `high` = front of cron queue (≥1k stars or strategic anchor); `normal` = bulk (100–999 stars); `low` = long-tail (<100 stars, industry-vertical accelerators). Drives [H0.20] cost-tracker budget allocation.

reason.description: One-line technical justification for inclusion. ≤200 chars recommended. Used as audit context when reviewers triage seed PRs and as the `harvested_from.notes` seed in [H0.3] manifest-v2 provenance.

expected_primary_cloud.description: Optional pre-classification hint matching repo-facts.schema.json `primary_cloud`. Drives [H0.25] lenient-mode classifier confidence floor. Omit if uncertain — classifier will infer.

expected_domain.description: Optional pre-classification hint matching repo-facts.schema.json `domain` enum (15-member). Drives [H0.25] lenient-mode confidence floor. Omit if uncertain.

added_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC. When this seed was first added to the list. Pre-existing entries may omit; the harvest pipeline does not depend on it.

added_by.description: Optional. GitHub username of the seed PR author OR pipeline identifier. Examples: 'github:pavle', 'fai-harvest-seed-curator/v1.0'.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes. Use for: known caveats (archived/deprecated repos), licensing flags, expected play_slug hints, reviewer comments. NOT used at runtime — pure metadata.
